name: split into halves, XOR a keyed function of one half into the other, then swap
mechanism: split the block in two; each round computes a keyed function of the right half and XORs it into the left, then swaps the halves; because the function is only ever XORed in, decryption is the same sequence with the round keys reversed, and the round function need not be invertible
